tasks.title: Write the tracking repo: guarded mark writes, undo, and the mark reads every flow needs
tasks.dod: tracking-repo.integration.test.ts passes on a temp DB: upsert of the computed row, guarded undo (1 row vs 0 rows), first-mark undo deletes, write for a removed posting raises the FK error, and the marked-ids / marked-order / protected-among reads return the expected sets.

tasks.title: Implement the mark, change, clear and undo use cases with their error mapping and MarkState
tasks.dod: tracking-marks.integration.test.ts passes: setMark/undoMark return MarkState with the right at_risk and removed_after, map a removed posting to TRACKING_POSTING_NOT_FOUND, a stale undo to TRACKING_MARK_CHANGED_ELSEWHERE, and an injected write failure to TRACKING_MARKS_UNAVAILABLE with nothing written.

tasks.title: Implement ProtectedPostings in tracking and wire it into the collector in app.ts
tasks.dod: tracking-protected.integration.test.ts runs dailyCleanup with the real port: a skipped and an applied posting past 60 days → skipped removed (mark row cascaded), applied kept; an applied-lost posting kept through its grace day and removed the day after.

tasks.title: Implement tracking's read queries for search: marked ids, the marked order, and look-alike hints
tasks.dod: tracking-queries.integration.test.ts passes: markedIds reflects current marks; markedOrder returns marked + cleared-closed rows newest first with at_risk/removed_after; hintsFor returns the AC-10 hint for the ACME posting, none for a different title, none for a cleared match.

tasks.title: Expose setMark and undoMark as Fastify routes behind the access guard and register the tracking plugin
tasks.dod: tracking-routes.integration.test.ts validates every response against the applied-skipped contract (loadContract) for 200/400/404/409/415/503, and requests with a foreign Host or Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site are refused 403 with no mark recorded.

tasks.title: Make search's main list mark-aware: snapshot keeps marked, pages skip them, counts and hints
tasks.dod: search-marks.integration.test.ts passes (marked left out of first and next pages, cleared-since returns in place, nothing skipped, total/new_count/marked_count right, nothing-left state, waiting counts unmarked only, look_alike set); runSearch/getNextPage/getWaitingCount responses validate against the applied-skipped contract; search NFR test holds ≤1 s p95 with 10,000 open and 5,000 marked.

tasks.title: Add search's marked view: a fixed-order marked snapshot with skills, closed and cleared postings
tasks.dod: search-marked.integration.test.ts passes: runMarkedView returns marked + cleared-closed postings newest first with marked_count/cleared_count, skills narrow over every listing, closed postings name every source with links only for open listings; getNextMarkedPage never repeats or skips and shows fresh mark_state; responses validate against the contract; first 50 ≤1 s p95 with 5,000 marked and 20 skills.

tasks.dod: MarkActions.test.tsx covers unmarked / marked / pending / confirm states and accessible names; PostingCard.test.tsx renders the look-alike line as text from the runSearch found_with_hint example and the marked variant from the runMarkedView example; the api clients' types match the applied-skipped contract examples.

tasks.title: Wire marking and the 8-second Undo notice into the main list

tasks.title: Show the save-error, posting-gone and nothing-left-to-review states on the main screen
tasks.dod: Home.test.tsx shows: a 503 on setMark or undoMark keeps the earlier state with the API message and Retry that repeats the call; a 404 removes the card with 'This posting is no longer in job-radar.' and no Undo; runSearch nothing_left example renders 'Nothing left to review. You've marked 3 matching postings.' with one Show marked postings action; marked_count 0 keeps search's messages.

tasks.title: Build the Show marked postings switch and the marked view with change, clear, at-risk confirm and cleared cards
tasks.dod: Home.test.tsx shows: the switch starts off, turning it on runs runMarkedView and lists marked cards with Badge and date, '12 marked and 1 cleared', Closed with links only for open listings, Cleared with 'Removed after 8 Oct'; change and clear update the card in place with Undo; an at_risk applied card asks Continue/Cancel before any call; 410 reloads with the expired message; turning it off reloads the main list.
